story_intro_1: 昔々、現世とあの世の間に大きな門がありました〜 ✨
story_intro_2:
解怨の門と呼ばれるこの門にひびが入った！
ゴゴゴ〜 可愛い幽霊たちが押し寄せてきます！
story_intro_3:
うわあ！あそこ見て！楽しそうな奴らがいっぱい来てるぞ？！
俺も遊ぶ〜！！🎉
story_intro_4:
ふざけないで。あの子たちは迷って彷徨っているの。
正しい道へ導かなきゃ！準備しましょう！💪
story_ep1to2_1: 市場の騒ぎが収まった！でも山の向こうで何かガサガサと… 🌲
story_ep1to2_2:
あら〜 可愛い動物たちが山で遊んでるみたい？
見に行ってみましょうか〜？*しっぽフリフリ* ♡
story_ep2to3_1: 森の動物たちも帰ったわ。でも薄い霧が立ち込めて森が神秘的に〜 🌿
story_ep2to3_2:
…霧の中で誰かが迷って泣いている。
私が助けるわ、心配しないで〜 💧
story_ep3to4_1:
霧の中の友達みんなを助けた！でも噂が〜
誰かが宮殿で大騒ぎしてるって！🏯
story_ep4to5_1:
宮殿の騒ぎ解決！でも今度は門が大きく開いちゃった！
最後の冒険が待ってる〜 ✨
story_ep4to5_2:
いよいよ最後の門！みんなで力を合わせれば大丈夫！
一緒に行こう〜！🌸
story_ep4to5_3: よし、みんなで行くぞ。今回は本当にカッコいいところを見せてやる！🌟
lore_kkaebi:
A mischievous goblin born from an old broom! He loved the mortal world's toys so much that he enthusiastically joined in guarding the Gateway~ 🎉

Wearing discarded straw shoes and practicing wrestling diligently, he's now strong enough to lift troublesome ghosts with ease! Destined to inherit the crown of the Goblin King!
lore_miho:
A young fox with only one tail! She prayed at the Gateway wanting to make human friends and became a guardian~ 🦊

With each adventure, she grows another tail, and one day when her nine tails shine bright, she'll become a magnificent nine-tailed fox guiding lost souls to heaven!
lore_gangrim:
A rookie grim reaper wearing a traditional hat! Still a beginner but more responsible than anyone~ 😎

By diligently completing missions, he became a full-fledged reaper, and someday he'll be appointed as the King of the Underworld's representative!
lore_sua:
A water spirit with a pure heart! A caring guardian who always worries about friends being in danger near water~ 💧

Growing stronger to become the master of the marsh, she binds evil spirits' feet with her clear song! Eventually she'll magnificently grow into a spirit of the great ocean!
lore_bari:
A cute little shrine princess! A genius who purifies all bad energy with just a bell ring~ 🌸

Comforting troubled friends to become the greatest priestess, she blooms the flower of life to create an invincible shield for all allies!
skin_kkaebiInferno_lore: A goblin who commands the underworld's flames. His club turns enemies to ash.
skin_kkaebiGoldhorn_lore: King of goblins who trained for a millennium. His golden horn bends the enemy's will.
skin_mihoCrimson_lore: A blood-thirsty Miho. Her fox bell grows stronger feeding on enemy blood.
skin_mihoNine_lore: A celestial fox with all nine tails bloomed. Miho with the essence of the moon can command souls.
skin_gangrimBlood_lore: A reaper who crossed the blood river of the afterlife. Only death remains where his scythe reaches.
skin_gangrimReaper_eff: Golden particles + 0.5% gem drop on kill
skin_gangrimReaper_lore: King of the afterlife. Knight commander bearing the silence of the Underworld King.

season_1_theme: 桜散る漢陽、解怨の門が開く
lore_hungryGhost_basic: A lost soul that died of starvation. Cold energy endlessly flows from its mouth.
lore_hungryGhost_secret: The Hungry Ghosts were actually citizens who never received aid during the great famine. Their grudge resurfaces whenever they smell warm food from the living.
lore_hungryGhost_hidden: Legend says if you appease a thousand Hungry Ghosts, one spirit leaves a golden spoon in gratitude. Market merchants would make offerings every night.
lore_strawShoe_basic: An old man's spirit slowly approaching in worn straw shoes. He taps towers with his cane.
lore_strawShoe_secret: In life, the Elder walked a hundred li to the market for medicine but never arrived, stopping forever on the road. Only his straw shoes remained.
lore_strawShoe_hidden: Finding a pair of the Elder's shoes is said to grant the mystical power of never slipping on any path.
lore_laborer_basic: A high-HP, slow but steadily pushing spirit. Carries a rack full of grudges.
lore_laborer_secret: The Laborer was a servant who died with a broken back carrying a nobleman's heavy load. Inside were actually government grains the nobleman had embezzled.
lore_laborer_hidden: Legend says if you help the Laborer set down his rack, treasures pour out like a mountain.
lore_maidenGhost_basic: Three spirits of maidens who died unmarried wander as grudges. Fast with high evasion.
lore_maidenGhost_secret: This Maiden Ghost was actually a noble lady who took her life after being violated by the magistrate's son. He was never punished, and her grudge persists forever.
lore_maidenGhost_hidden: Red camellias on the railing are said to be stained with the Maiden's tears. Picking them surely brings misfortune.
lore_eggGhost_basic: A faceless white-faced ghost. Seeing it petrifies towers momentarily.
lore_eggGhost_secret: Egg Ghosts are anonymous souls whose names were never recorded. Without names they have no faces, rejected even by the afterlife.
lore_eggGhost_hidden: If you sincerely give an Egg Ghost a name, a smile blooms on its blurred face. It then reveals hidden treasures as thanks.
lore_bossOgre_basic: A massive goblin ruling the market. One swing of his club crumbles mountains.
lore_bossOgre_secret: The Goblin Chief was originally a guardian deity of the market. But seeing too much human greed, he fell and began destroying what he once protected.
lore_bossOgre_hidden: The Chief's club is actually one of a pair—one that creates gold and one that takes it away. Humans blinded by greed always pick the wrong one.
lore_tigerSlave_basic: A changwi enslaved after being devoured by a tiger. Lures other prey.
lore_tigerSlave_secret: Those who become changwi are tricked by a false promise that they can be freed by finding new prey for the tiger that ate them.
lore_tigerSlave_hidden: If just one servant finds the courage to betray the tiger, all changwi would be freed. But no one dares to go first.
lore_fireDog_basic: A mythical beast that breathes fire. Leaves flames wherever it passes.
lore_fireDog_secret: Fire Dogs were celestial beasts that chased the sun and moon but failed repeatedly, banished to earth. Their rage erupts as fire.
lore_fireDog_hidden: If a Fire Dog succeeds in swallowing the sun, the world becomes eternal night. Ancient sages drove them away by banging gongs and drums.
lore_shadowGolem_basic: A giant formed from forest shadows. Extremely slow but each hit shatters mountains.
lore_shadowGolem_secret: The Shadow Golem is the spirit of a millennium-old tree. The grudge of loggers clearing the forest took shadow form.
lore_shadowGolem_hidden: In the Golem's heart sleeps a seed from a thousand years ago. Planting it is said to revive the forest in a single day.
lore_foxWoman_basic: A millennium-old fox turned human. Disables towers with charm abilities.
lore_foxWoman_secret: This fox tried to become human but lacked one final liver, making the transformation incomplete. She wanders eternally as half-human.
lore_foxWoman_hidden: The nine-tailed fox's wish-granting pearl is said to cure all ailments. But taking it means the fox can never become human, so she guards it with her life.
lore_imugi_basic: A millennium-old serpent that failed to become a dragon. Devours everything with its grudge of failed ascension.
lore_imugi_secret: To become a dragon, the Imugi must swim up a waterfall with a pearl in its mouth. This ancient one always fell at the very last step.
lore_imugi_hidden: Legend says collecting a thousand Imugi scales can ward off the dragon's stench, so warriors hunted the Imugi.
lore_bossMountain_basic: A supernatural tiger ruling the forest. A single roar splits boulders.
lore_bossMountain_secret: The Mountain King was the mountain spirit's holy steed, but usurped the throne while the spirit slept. Now the mountain itself is his domain.
lore_bossMountain_hidden: Each of the King's fangs holds a fragment of the mountain spirit's power. Many heroes tried to collect them all to awaken the sleeping spirit, but none returned.
lore_hero_kkaebi_basic: A mischievous goblin. Loves wrestling and is one of few goblins friendly to humans.
lore_hero_kkaebi_secret: Kkaebi was originally the Goblin Chief's sworn brother. But when the Chief fell to corruption, Kkaebi chose the human side and was banished from goblin society.
lore_hero_kkaebi_hidden: Kkaebi's true power comes from the Hat of Friendship. Wearing it multiplies his strength tenfold, but it vanishes when he's lonely. That's why Kkaebi always smiles.
lore_hero_miho_basic: Descendant of the nine-tailed fox. Unleashes powerful magic with her wish pearl.
lore_hero_miho_secret: Miho inherited the grudge of her mother fox who failed to become human. But Miho is different—she chose to fight alongside humans instead of hunting them.
lore_hero_miho_hidden: Each of Miho's nine tails holds a different emotion. The ninth tail holds "love." When this tail shines, Miho is at her strongest.
lore_hero_gangrim_basic: A grim reaper. Guiding souls of the dead is his job, but circumstances sent him to the mortal realm.
lore_hero_gangrim_secret: Gangrim was originally human. The first human to pass the Underworld King's test and become a reaper, he understands human grudges better than anyone.
lore_hero_gangrim_hidden: Gangrim's real reason for becoming a reaper was to retrieve his beloved's soul. But reaper rules forbid him from ever meeting that soul—this is Gangrim's eternal grudge.
lore_hero_sua_basic: Descendant of water spirits. Slows and pulls enemies with water power.
lore_hero_sua_secret: Sua's mother was a spirit who drowned, but found peace with a shaman's help. Sua continues her work, appeasing water spirits with grudges.
lore_hero_sua_hidden: What Sua truly fears isn't water but "being forgotten." A water spirit's fate is to create new victims for freedom, but Sua is the only one who rejected that destiny.
lore_hero_bari_basic: An abandoned princess who became a shaman. Possesses healing and revival powers.
lore_hero_bari_secret: According to the Baridegi tale, Bari was abandoned as the ninth daughter but traveled to the afterlife for healing water to save her dead parents.
lore_hero_bari_hidden: Bari brought three waters from the afterlife: water that revives, water that makes you forget, and water that makes you remember. Bari always uses the third one first.
lore_world_market_basic: A Joseon market ruined by famine. Starving spirits wander seeking last warmth.
lore_world_market_secret: This market is the tragic site of a corrupt official who burned the granary. All spirits here were created by one person's greed.
lore_world_market_hidden: The sotdae at the market's center bears the prayer "Never let them starve again." When it glows, spirits can briefly smell warm rice.
lore_world_forest_basic: A forest that echoes with wailing every night. A dangerous zone ruled by beasts and yokai.
lore_world_forest_secret: The trees in the Wailing Forest are actually alive. Wails from stumps of felled trees echo throughout the forest.
lore_world_forest_hidden: Deep in the forest is said to be the "First Tree." Finding it makes the forest whisper all its secrets. But revealing those secrets turns you into a tree, trapped forever.
lore_world_faceless_basic: A misty forest where faceless spirits wander. Unidentifiable shadow figures roam.
lore_world_faceless_secret: This forest emerged when a traitor's family was annihilated. The grudges of those whose names and faces were erased became fog.
lore_world_faceless_hidden: Facing your true face in this forest makes it your most feared enemy. Those who enter must walk with eyes closed.
lore_world_palace_basic: A palace stained by power. A cursed court teeming with assassination and intrigue.
lore_world_palace_secret: Beneath the palace, the heads of loyal subjects executed by the king are sealed. Every year on Hansik, these heads cry out the truth.
lore_world_palace_hidden: The palace taboo — "He who sits upon the throne shall change his shadow." Those who learn the true meaning cannot leave the palace alive.
lore_world_death_basic: The boundary between life and death. Cross it, and you cannot return alive.
lore_world_death_secret: The Threshold is guarded by three gatekeepers. The first judges the past, the second the present, and the third the future.
lore_world_death_hidden: When Baridegi crossed this threshold, the gatekeeper asked — "What will you do if you return alive?" Bari answered — "I will forgive those who abandoned me." This answer opened the gate.

tut1_content:
ここは現世と冥界の間の解怨門です。
マスターとなり、怨みの悪鬼を浄化し
魂を昇天させましょう！
tut2_content:
下のタワーアイコンを長押しして
緑の配置スロットにドラッグしてください。

タワーは神明(⚡)資源で建設します。
良い位置に配置すると戦闘が有利になります！
tut3_content:
🔥 火 烽火台 — 範囲攻撃
💧 水 仙女泉 — 減速/デバフ
🌿 木 神木 — 多段攻撃
⚔️ 金 鐘楼 — 単体強打
🪨 土 石祠 — 兵士召喚

属性の組み合わせが戦略の核心です！
tut4_content:
☀️ 昼は火・木タワーが強化されます。
🌙 夜は水・金タワーが強化され
  ステルス敵が出現します。
⏳ 移行期には土タワーが強化されます。

時間帯に合わせてタワーを配置しましょう！
tut5_content:
敵を倒すと怨魂が落ち
自動浄化で神明(資源)を獲得！

⚠️ 浄化が滞ると「哭声」ゲージが
上昇しタワーが弱体化、100%になると
全ての敵が暴走します！
tut6_content:
英雄は範囲内の敵を自動攻撃し
スキルもクールタイムが終わると自動発動します。

💡 英雄をタッチすると即座にスキル発動！
ドラッグで位置を移動できます。

準備はいいですか？戦闘開始です！

hero_kkaebi_backstory: 古い箒に宿ったトッケビの魂。人間界のおもちゃが好きで、解冤門を守る仕事に加わり、相撲で悪鬼を制圧します。
hero_kkaebi_arc_unlock: 古い箒から生まれたいたずら好きのトッケビ。人間界のおもちゃが好きで、解冤門を守る仕事に加わった。
hero_kkaebi_arc_evolution: 誰かが捨てた藁靴を履き、相撲の技を習得した。今では雑鬼を軽々と持ち上げて投げ飛ばすほどの力持ちだ。
hero_kkaebi_arc_ultimate: トッケビ王の冠を授かった。隠れた敵の首根っこを掴む伝説の守護者となる。
hero_kkaebi_skill_name: 投げ技（スープレックス）
hero_kkaebi_skill_desc: 敵を持ち上げて後ろに投げ飛ばします（ノックバック）。
hero_kkaebi_evo_base_desc: 古い藁靴を履き、短い箒を持つ姿。
hero_kkaebi_evo_mid_desc: 体が大きく筋肉質になり、まわしを締める。
hero_kkaebi_evo_ult_desc: 虎の皮を纏いトッケビの冠を被る姿。ステルス奇襲。
hero_kkaebi_bark_deploy: 相撲の土俵だ！かかって来い！
hero_kkaebi_bark_skill: あれ？これ重い？全然軽いけど！
hero_kkaebi_bark_idle: 暇だなぁ…誰か相撲しない？
hero_kkaebi_bark_boss: おい兄さん、角の手入れがなってないぞ？
hero_miho_title: 千年の誘惑 九尾狐
hero_miho_backstory: 人間になりたがる小さな狐。解冤門の前で祈りを捧げて守護者となり、青い狐火で悪鬼を浄化します。
hero_miho_arc_unlock: 尻尾が一本しかない幼い狐。人間になりたくて解冤門の前で祈りを捧げて守護者となった。
hero_miho_arc_evolution: 苦難を乗り越え、尻尾が五本に増えた。彼女の狐珠は今や冷たい夜を照らす青い聖火となった。
hero_miho_arc_ultimate: ついに九尾狐の資格に到達した。9本の尻尾が踊るたびに、怨霊たちは解放され昇天する。
hero_miho_skill_name: 狐珠（フォックスファイア）
hero_miho_skill_desc: エネルギーを集めて発射。敵の精気を吸収してマナ回復。
hero_miho_evo_base_desc: 尻尾が1本の可愛い狐娘。
hero_miho_evo_mid_desc: 尻尾が5本、青い狐火を投げる。
hero_miho_bark_deploy: 私の炎は温かいよ。敵にはちょっと熱いけど！
hero_miho_bark_idle: 人間になったら、まずトッポッキを食べるんだ。
hero_gangrim_backstory: 黒い笠と道袍を纏う冷静な冥府の使者。名簿の名前を消していく仕事に並々ならぬ責任感を持ちます。
hero_gangrim_arc_unlock: 笠を被った新人の使者。まだ不慣れだが、名簿の名前を消す仕事に並々ならぬ責任感を感じている。
hero_gangrim_arc_evolution: 数多くの任務を遂行し、正式な使者の衣を賜った。彼が現れると空気さえ凍りつく。
hero_gangrim_arc_ultimate: 閻魔大王の代行者に任命された。彼が名を呼ぶ瞬間、いかなる悪鬼も裁きの鎌から逃れることはできない。
hero_gangrim_skill_name: 呼名（コーリングネーム）
hero_gangrim_skill_desc: 敵の名を呼び、HP30%以下の敵を即死させる。
hero_gangrim_evo_base_desc: みすぼらしい衣。名簿が破れている。
hero_gangrim_evo_mid_desc: 黒い笠と衣。射程が大幅に増加。
hero_gangrim_evo_ult_desc: 黒いオーラ。敵の魂を資源に還元。
hero_gangrim_bark_deploy: 名簿に名が記されている以上…逃れられぬ。
hero_gangrim_bark_skill: 名前三文字、もう一度呼ぼう。
hero_gangrim_bark_boss: 戸籍から名前を消させてもらおう。
hero_sua_backstory: 無念の死を遂げた水の幽霊少女。他の魂が同じ悲劇を繰り返さないよう、冷たい水の中で門を守ります。
hero_sua_arc_unlock: 濡れた白い服を着た処女の幽霊。無念にも溺死した彼女は、他の魂が同じ道を歩まないことを願う。
hero_sua_arc_evolution: 恨みを超越し、沼の主となった。彼女の悲しい歌は敵の足取りを重く縛りつける。
hero_sua_arc_ultimate: 大海水の精霊として生まれ変わった。巨大な水柱を起こし、侵入者を永遠の深海の入り口へ送り返す。
hero_sua_skill_name: 足首掴み（ウォーターグラスプ）
hero_sua_skill_desc: 地面から濡れた手が現れ、敵の移動速度を90%減少させる。
hero_sua_evo_base_desc: 白い服を着た乙女。髪で敵に触れる。
hero_sua_evo_mid_desc: 周囲を沼地にして広域スロー。
hero_sua_evo_ult_desc: 巨大な水柱で敵をスタート地点に送還。
hero_sua_bark_skill: 足が冷たいでしょ？ふふ…
hero_sua_bark_idle: 一人は寂しい…友達を作らなきゃ。
hero_bari_backstory: 捨てられた王女であり天賦の才を持つ巫女。祓いの儀式と鈴の音で、現世のゆがんだ気を鎮めます。
hero_bari_arc_unlock: 捨てられた王女であり小さな巫女。鈴の音一つで現世のゆがんだ気を鎮める天賦の才を持つ。
hero_bari_arc_evolution: 苦しむ者たちを慰め、万神の境地に至った。彼女が舞うたびに、戦場の塔は再び立ち上がる。
hero_bari_arc_ultimate: 生命花の主、神憑り状態に到達する。全ての味方に神の加護を授け、死すら拒む無敵の領域を作り出す。
hero_bari_skill_desc: 踊りながら周囲の味方の攻撃速度を2倍にする。
hero_bari_evo_mid_desc: 五方色の衣。タワーHPを回復。
hero_bari_evo_ult_desc: 神が降臨し、味方全体を3秒間無敵にする。
hero_bari_bark_deploy: 祓いの儀式を始めます。
hero_bari_bark_idle: 花が咲けば、全ての恨みが晴れるでしょう。
tower_archer_desc: 連射が速い。空中ユニット迎撃に特化。
tower_barracks_desc: 兵士3名を召喚して道を塞ぐ（ブロッキング）。
tower_shaman_desc: 広域魔法/浄化。高防御の敵に貫通。
tower_artillery_desc: 遅いが強力な広域爆発。密集した敵に効果的。
tower_sotdae_desc: 守護結界で味方タワーにデバフ耐性 + 怨ゲージ抑制。Lv2からステルス敵感知。
tower_sotdae_lv2_ability: デバフ耐性70%、攻速+15%、ステルス感知
tower_sotdae_lv3_ability: デバフ耐性90%、範囲/バフ+50%、ステルス感知
branch_rocket_battery_desc: 広域爆発ロケットを発射。密集した敵に効果的。
branch_rocket_battery_ability: ロケット爆発：範囲60スプラッシュ
branch_spirit_hunter_desc: 一撃必殺。防御貫通 + ステルス感知。
branch_spirit_hunter_ability: 貫通 + ステルス感知
branch_general_totem_desc: チャンスン兵士が敵をしっかり防ぎます。HP3倍。
branch_goblin_ring_desc: トッケビが敵を1対1で捕まえて制圧。
branch_goblin_ring_ability: 1対1制圧 + 撃破時シンミョンボーナス150%
branch_shaman_temple_desc: 刃の上で踊り、広域呪いを放つ。
branch_shaman_temple_ability: 刃踊り：敵移動速度30%減少
branch_grim_reaper_desc: 冥府の使者がHP8%以下の敵を即座に連れ去る。盾を貫通して直接HPにダメージ。
branch_fire_dragon_desc: 炎弾で残留火傷ダメージを与える。
branch_heavenly_thunder_desc: 天の雷を落として範囲内の敵全員を2秒間気絶させる。遅い発射速度の代わりに強力なCCで前線を支える制御型砲台。
branch_heavenly_thunder_ability: 天雷：範囲2秒気絶 + 500ダメージ
branch_phoenix_totem_desc: デバフ免疫 + 怨抑制50%。全タワーのデバフ解除 + ステルス敵感知。
branch_phoenix_totem_ability: デバフ免疫 + 怨抑制50% + ステルス感知
branch_earth_spirit_desc: 大地の力で敵攻撃力-20% + 減速オーラ20% + ステルス敵感知。
